display_name: CabinZero Classic Cabin Backpack 36L — evidence-rich prototype
raw_text: Classic Cabin Backpack 36L. Weight 700 g. Capacity 36L. Dimensions 45 x 31 x 20 cm. Cabin-sized; listed for 117 airlines. Price £60.00. Body: 600 denier polyester fabric. Abrasion-resistant fabric. Water-resistant coating. YKK zippers. Lifetime warranty. Suspended laptop sleeve. Spacious inner zip pocket. Spacious inner zip mesh pocket. Quick access zip pocket. Front-loading clamshell opening. PROPOSED BACK-SUPPORT COPY — OWNER VERIFICATION REQUIRED BEFORE PUBLICATION: a ventilated air-mesh back panel keeps airflow moving; 12 mm padded shoulder straps and an adjustable sternum strap distribute the load. CARRY-COMFORT FAQ: Is this the right bag for an all-day walk? For light-to-moderate loads, the curved foam shoulder straps are designed for comfortable urban carry. The Classic 36L has no load-bearing hip belt or internal frame. INDEPENDENT REVIEW SUMMARIES: Pack Hacker found the straps comfortable when the pack was not overloaded. A Classic 36L owner reported carrying it for over an hour without problems, but not for long hiking.
